statement: For the literal normalized inverse-weight LLY flow on the labelled weighted triangle in source.md, all three curvatures are finite exactly on G={(a,b,c)>0:a+b+c=1, max(a,b,c)<=1/2}. On G they are given, for an edge x with other lengths y,z and M=max(y,z), m=min(y,z), by k_x=1+M(x+2m-M)/((x+y)(x+z)); the normalized vector field F_x=-x(k_x-sum_u u k_u) is locally Lipschitz, G is forward invariant, and every datum in G has a unique global classical trajectory that reaches neither a new ordering wall nor the non-finiteness locus in finite time. After permuting labels so a>=b>=c, every trajectory is exactly one of: the constant equal point; a>b=c, converging to (1/2,1/4,1/4); or b>c (allowing a=b), converging to (1/2,1/2,0). The only equilibria in G are (1/3,1/3,1/3) and the three labelled permutations of (1/2,1/4,1/4), and the corresponding singleton limits are all omega-limit sets.
contribution: This gives a complete exact transport-cell, well-posedness, invariant-stratum, equilibrium, boundary-degeneration, and omega-limit classification for the frozen literal triangle problem. The proof uses explicit primal/dual Wasserstein certificates and exact rational log-ratio factors; it is confined to C3 and does not assert a theorem for arbitrary cyclic graphs or import the tree results.
